instruction: Create an ORIGINAL PURE-DART reusable package named aivexus_count_in_range, Dart SDK >=3.3.0 <4.0.0. Implement exactly this PUBLIC TOP-LEVEL Dart function in lib/count_in_range.dart: int countInRange(List<int> input, int lower, int upper). Return the number of signed integers x in input with lower <= x <= upper (both bounds inclusive). Repetitions count. If lower > upper return 0. Do not modify input or do IO. Fully implement working behavior yourself, not a stub. Write reasonable tests under test/. You may use Dart core List, Map, Set, loops and standard library methods only. No third-party runtime dependencies, networking, filesystem, FFI, shell or privileged APIs. Always use valid Dart SDK APIs and compileable types. Return the strict JSON source object requested by the system prompt.
